title: Facial Cue Training Lesson Schema
description: Schema for lessons in the facial cue training application
lessonName: Advanced Sarcasm: Shared Deadpan and Reciprocity

pages.definition: A subtle form of sarcasm delivered with a completely neutral expression and flat tone, often indistinguishable from a serious statement except for context. In advanced interactions, the listener is expected to not only detect the sarcasm but reciprocate it to build rapport, rather than simply acknowledging the contradiction.
visualCues: Complete lack of smiling or smirking

scenario.context: You and a colleague are staring at a printer that has jammed for the third time this morning.
scenario.description: The atmosphere is frustrating, but your colleague turns to you with a completely serious face while holding a crumpled piece of paper covered in toner.

audioSample.tonalPrompt: Flat, serious, slight hint of weariness but no distinct inflection change.

pages.transcript: This is a marvel of modern engineering. I think we should nominate it for employee of the month.

appropriateResponse.description: Do not laugh or point out the sarcasm explicitly. Instead, validate the absurdity by adding to the praise of the broken machine.
keyElements: Agree with the premise (the machine is 'good')
Escalate the sarcasm slightly (e.g., suggest a promotion)

scenario.context: You and a friend arrive at a camping site, but it is currently being swarmed by mosquitoes.
scenario.description: You are both swatting away bugs. Your friend stops swatting for a moment to speak, looking around calmly.

audioSample.tonalPrompt: Calm, appreciative tone, contradicting the physical annoyance of the situation.

pages.transcript: I'm really glad we came. I felt like I had too much blood anyway. It's nice to share.

appropriateResponse.description: Engage in the shared coping mechanism. The goal is to bond over the misery through humor without breaking character.
keyElements: Frame the blood loss as a positive or charitable act

scenario.context: You are at a high-end art gallery looking at a canvas that is completely blank white.
scenario.description: You and an acquaintance are standing in front of it. The price tag reads $50,000.

audioSample.tonalPrompt: Intellectual, pensive, hushed whisper usually reserved for profound art.

pages.transcript: The complexity is overwhelming. It really challenges your perception of... everything. So bold.

appropriateResponse.description: Participate in the intellectual critique of nothingness. Reciprocate the pretentious tone to mock the situation together.
keyElements: Focus on the 'depth' of the blank canvas
